controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE host.name == "web-2"
        AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-11T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:06:42.000Z"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)
        BY host.ip
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 10
